literal: blame without abundant yield will decrease fame without body that bore earth
translation: The earth that bears a body destitute of fame will shrink in its flawless, abundant yield.
modern: புகழ் இல்லாத மனிதர்களின் உடம்பைச் சுமந்த நிலமானது, தன்னுடைய குற்றமற்ற வளமான விளைச்சலில் குறைந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet connects human renown with the fertility of the earth. It states that if the earth has to bear the weight of a person who lives without fame, it will suffer a loss in its own natural abundance. The phrase 'வசை இலா வண்பயன்' refers to the flawless, rich yield of the land. By contrasting a blameless harvest with a fameless existence, the poet suggests that a life lived without earning good repute is a burden so unnatural that it blights the very ground it walks upon.
